onbSubtitle.message: AI token usage monitoring for Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini — three quick steps to get started.

permTitle.message: Why Token Watcher asks for each permission

permIntro.message: Nothing below reads your messages. Each permission is used only for the purpose listed.

permHostsName.message: Access to claude.ai, chatgpt.com and gemini.google.com

permHostsBody.message: Lets the extension read token counts and quota figures from these three sites. It is not used on any other site.

permCookiesBody.message: Lets the extension make quota requests to your signed-in provider account without asking you to paste a key. Cookie values are never stored or sent anywhere.

permStorageBody.message: Keeps your settings and usage history on this device.

permAlarmsBody.message: Schedules periodic refreshes and pauses them while your computer is idle.

permNotificationsBody.message: Shows an alert when usage crosses a threshold you chose.

permTabsBody.message: Finds your open provider tabs and runs the usage gauge in them.

permLocalhostBody.message: Only requested if you turn on sharing with Token Watcher Core running on your own computer.

onbPrivacyBody.message: Your usage data stays on your device. Token Watcher reads token counts and quota figures only; it never reads message content and has no analytics or tracking servers. It talks only to the provider sites you use (and to localhost if you opt in).

privIntro.message: Token Watcher is local-first. This page explains what is stored, for how long, how to delete it, and what is never collected.

privLocalBody.message: Settings, per-provider quota snapshots (up to 7 days), recent token-count events (up to 2,000), and optional local analytics events (up to 90 days). All of it lives in this browser profile's extension storage.

privCloudBody.message: None. Token Watcher has no cloud sync and no servers of its own. If you opt in to sharing with Token Watcher Core, metadata-only events go to localhost:7734 on your own computer and nowhere else.

privNetBody.message: The extension contacts only claude.ai, chatgpt.com and gemini.google.com, using your existing signed-in session, to read your own quota figures.

privRetBody.message: Quota snapshots are trimmed to the last 7 days, token events to the most recent 2,000, and analytics events to 90 days. Removing the extension deletes everything it stored.

privDelBody.message: Use "Delete all analytics data" in Extension Settings to clear local analytics immediately, or remove the extension to clear all stored data.

privNever2.message: Attachments, conversation titles, or page contents

privNever3.message: Cookie values, API keys, or passwords

privNever4.message: Full URLs, or any data sold or shared with third parties

extDescription.message: Track AI token usage across Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini in real-time. Monitor session limits, view history, and get alerts before you hit your limit.
extDescription.description: Extension store description (max 132 characters is recommended by Chrome).

popWaitingHint.message: Open a signed-in Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini tab to collect usage automatically

setAlertsHint.message: Show desktop notifications when thresholds are crossed

setThresholdsHint.message: Each threshold fires once per session window, then re-arms when the window resets.

setT80.message: Approaching limit — good time to wrap up

setGaugeHint.message: Show the compact quota gauge on supported provider pages

setCoreLabel.message: Share usage with local Token Watcher Core

setCoreHint.message: Opt in to sending metadata-only events to localhost:7734. Prompts and responses are never sent.

popOpenTabFetch.message: Open a signed-in tab to fetch usage.

popUpdateFailed.message: Last update failed$1 · showing last known data. $2

popOverLimit.message: Claude rate limit reached — resets in $1

popLedgerOpen.message: Full ledger is in the dashboard

popLedgerEmpty.message: No usage evidence yet. Open a signed-in Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini tab.

popLedgerError.message: Could not read the ledger. Try again in a moment.

popLedgerStale.message: Some provider data is stale. Figures may lag the real quota.

popLedgerPartial.message: Partial: browser activity collection is off or a provider has no reading. Unattributed use is not computed here.

popLedgerOk.message: Unattributed use is not computed here. Token counts are estimates, not billing.

popLedgerObserved.message: Estimated from $1 message(s) seen here in 24h

apInsufficientNoData.message: Not enough data yet. Open a signed-in Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini tab so Autopilot can read your quota.

apInsufficientNone.message: No signed-in provider is available right now, so there is nothing to recommend.

apBenefit.message: About $1% of quota left after your reserve

apBenefitUnknown.message: Quota left is unknown for this provider

apNotQuality.message: This compares remaining quota and risk, not model quality.

apCoarse.message: Forecasts here are rough estimates from recent readings in this browser.

apStaleNotice.message: Some quota data is out of date, so treat this as a guess.

apAllLimited.message: Every available provider is at its limit.

apWaitUnknown.message: No reset time is known. Check the providers directly.

apWaitAck.message: Noted. Autopilot updates when a provider resets.

apWarn_stale_data.message: Quota data is out of date.

apWarn_no_history.message: There is not enough history to forecast.

apWarn_limit_expected_soon.message: The limit may arrive within 30 minutes.

apWarn_high_exhaustion_risk.message: Limit risk is high before the reset.

apWarn_pinned_unavailable.message: Your preferred provider has no data.

apWarn_pinned_blocked.message: Your preferred provider is at its limit.

apWarn_pinned_ineligible.message: Your preferred provider is not usable right now.

apWarn_close_call.message: The next option is nearly as good.

apWarn_conflicting_windows.message: Another usage window is at its limit.

apWarnOutsideHours.message: Outside your working hours, five-hour limits are not counted.

apConsidered_unauthenticated.message: $1: no recent reading, or signed out

apSetHint.message: Recommends which provider to use next from your remaining quota. It never reads prompts or conversations.

apSetEnabledHint.message: Turn off to hide the recommendation card

apSetTaskHint.message: Used with your own provider preference, never as a quality ranking

apSetReserveHint.message: Percent of each window to keep back, from 0 to 90

apSetHoursHint.message: Outside these hours five-hour limits are not counted. Uses this computer's time zone.

apSetNotifyHint.message: Decides which Autopilot alerts are shown. See Decision alerts below.

apSetPinned.message: Prefer this provider when it is usable

alHint.message: Notifies you when the recommended action changes, a block looks likely, or a useful reset is near. Frequency is set under Autopilot above.

alQuietHint.message: No notifications during these hours. Uses this computer's time zone.

alExperimentHint.message: Compares simple threshold alerts with Autopilot alerts. Stays on this device; turn off and remove the data any time.

alClear.message: Remove alert history and experiment data

alReport.message: Experiment ($1): $2 shown, $3 acted on, $4 dismissed, $5 false alarms, notifications turned off $6 times.

apAlert_changedWait_body.message: Every provider has reached its limit. Waiting for a reset is the best option.

apAlert_block_body.message: Quota is running down faster than the reset. Consider switching provider.

apAlert_reset_body.message: It will be available again in about 15 minutes.

apAlert_plan_body.message: Most of the week is left. Review your plan or spread out your usage.

apAlert_threshold_body.message: A usage window passed your alert threshold.

setCloudUnavailable.message: Not available in this build. Token Watcher stays local-only.

setCloudHint.message: Opt in to end-to-end encrypted sync. Usage is encrypted on this device first; prompts, responses and cookies are never synced.
